ORIGINAL 2D source sheet for an unlockable rapid-fire support/attack tower in a colorful bamboo-forest mobile tower-defense game. Tower concept: "Bamboo Burst". Playful plant-defense cartoon, chunky clean shapes, crisp outlines, saturated jade/gold palette, soft cel shading, phone-readable.

Identity: living bamboo cluster rooted in a mossy stone planter, three hollow bamboo tubes angled outward like organic seed launchers, flexible leaves, small friendly glowing seed-core at center, rotating bamboo-ring mechanism made from natural stems, no metal gun parts.

Create 5 isolated consistent states on warm off-white background:
1 folded young bamboo,
2 growth/activation,
3 active idle hero pose,
4 rapid seed/bamboo-pea burst firing pose,
5 upgraded variant with an extra tube and brighter core.
No text, no UI, no extra characters, original IP.
